origin: Unchanged original BlastNaWordFinder and scanner/mini-extension/diagonal/scoring dependencies execute directly, using the original stored C callbacks. Also directly executes masksubj.inl and Blast_UngappedStatsUpdate. Subject databases have no masking; query mask handling is retained.
